### Imports
```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
```

### Pulling triplets from data/triplets.parquet
```{python}
triplets_full = pd.read_parquet("../../data/triplets_full.parquet")
triplets_full.iloc[0][0]

triplets = triplets_full[['image1','image2','image3']].to_numpy(dtype=np.intp) - 1
```


### Getting similarity matrix from triplet data
Using helpers from https://github.com/florianmahner/similarity-factorization/
```{python}
from helpers import compute_similarity_matrix_from_triplets

# no extension
out_filename = 'computed_similarity'

S = compute_similarity_matrix_from_triplets(
    n=1854,
    triplets=triplets,
    alpha=1.0 # alpha is a smoothing strength coefficient, 1 is default
)
np.savez_compressed(f"../../data/{out_filename}.npz", similarity=S)
```
